bukti: The ECA attention mechanism was embedded into the classification subnet of RetinaNet to improve accuracy in detecting different levels of maturity in pineapples.
A new pineapple dataset was collected comprising four different growth stages under mild and severe complex scenarios.
catatan: Deteksi nanas di lahan dengan atribut kelas kematangan (empat tahap) dari citra tunggal; abstrak tidak melaporkan pencacahan, hanya mAP dan F1. Dikode C4 karena protokol memasukkan deteksi dengan atribut kelas; apabila C4 mensyaratkan pencacahan eksplisit, alternatifnya X/E5.

c1.hasil_ringkas: Hitungan dua sisi pohon dijumlahkan lalu dikalikan faktor koreksi per kebun (1,09; 1,04; 0,954); galat estimasi hasil 4,3%, 4,93%, dan 4,25% untuk Kebun A, B, dan C terhadap hitungan manual. Deteksi Deep-count F1 0,94.

bukti: For each tree, one image was taken at its front side and another image was taken at its backside
we first counted fruits of a tree from both sides that could be visually captured, and a correction factor was then adopted to include the hidden apples
The correlation factor was calculated as a ratio of the sum of manually counted fruits per tree in the real environment to that from images of both sides
catatan: Tidak ada identifikasi buah individual antarsisi; duplikat antarsisi hanya terserap oleh faktor koreksi (satu faktor di bawah 1). Kematangan (matang/belum matang) dievaluasi sebagai akurasi klasifikasi, bukan hitungan per kelas. Kamera RealSense D435i dipakai, tetapi depth tidak digunakan.

bukti: using images collected from vehicles driving along vineyard rows
Computer vision algorithms are applied to detect grape berries in images that have been registered together to generate high-resolution estimates.
We propose an underlying model relating image measurements to harvest yield and study practical approaches to calibrate the two.
catatan: Abstrak tidak merinci cara registrasi citra (diasumsikan registrasi geometris berbasis posisi kendaraan, M4) dan tidak menyatakan secara eksplisit bahwa registrasi menghapus duplikat. M1 berasal dari kalibrasi ukuran citra ke hasil panen.

bukti: a practical weighted grading strategy is introduced to map fruit-level recognition results to a five-grade (A-E) truss maturity index
The proposed system achieves a truss-level maturity assessment accuracy of 95.26% with 100% adjacent-tolerance accuracy
catatan: Deteksi buah tomat ceri pada tanaman dengan kelas kematangan, lalu agregasi berbobot per tandan dari citra tunggal; pencacahan per kelas hanya tersirat dalam strategi pembobotan dan tidak dilaporkan sebagai hasil hitung. Tidak ada asosiasi antarbingkai yang disebut dalam abstrak. Alternatif apabila pencacahan disyaratkan: X/E5.

bukti: we reviewed 75 full-text articles published between 1985 and 2021 for information on mathematical models related to banana growth and, fruit and fibre yield
Modellers often used multiple linear regression models to estimate banana plant growth and fruit yield.
catatan: Tinjauan sistematis, tetapi topiknya pemodelan matematis pertumbuhan dan hasil pisang, bukan metode berbasis citra yang mendeteksi buah; karena itu tidak dikode R.

bukti: Each image corresponds to a single oil palm FFB and was manually annotated into predefined ripeness categories, such as underripe, unripe, ripe, and overripe.
Image acquisition was performed using a standard digital camera without any near-infrared or multispectral sensors.
EfficientNet-B0 achieved the highest overall accuracy of 90.3%, while MobileNetV3 obtained the highest macro-averaged F1-score of 85.4%
catatan: Modalitas dikode RGB karena kanal NIR bersifat sintetis (dibangkitkan U-Net dari RGB), bukan hasil sensor. Citra diambil di kebun, tetapi naskah tidak menyatakan apakah tandan masih di pohon atau sudah di tanah, sehingga lokasi dikode ?.
